biriscv_pipe_ctrl.summary: Three-stage (E1, E2, WB) instruction pipeline controller: registers issued instruction info and control bits per stage, muxes ALU/CSR/div/mem/mul results, generates stall and exception-driven squash, and drives commit outputs.

blocks.name: E1 stage
blocks.description: Registers issued instruction, decoded class bits and early exception.

anchors.name: valid_e1_q
anchors.why: E1 stage valid bit, advanced into valid_e2_q.

anchors.name: ctrl_e1_q
anchors.why: E1 decoded class bits (alu/load/store/csr/div/mul/branch/rd) steering result mux and outputs.

anchors.name: pc_e1_q
anchors.why: E1 stage PC register, output on pc_e1_o.

anchors.name: opcode_e1_q
anchors.why: E1 stage opcode register providing rd index.

anchors.name: operand_ra_e1_q
anchors.why: E1 stage operand A register.

anchors.name: exception_e1_q
anchors.why: E1 exception code incl. misaligned fetch, propagated to E2.

anchors.name: npc_e1_q
anchors.why: E1 next-PC from branch target or pc+4.

anchors.name: branch_misaligned_w
anchors.why: Taken branch target misaligned, raises fetch exception into E1.

blocks.name: E2 stage
blocks.description: Result selection, mem/mul bypass and final exception resolution.

anchors.name: valid_e2_q
anchors.why: E2 stage valid bit, cleared on squash or E1 exception.

anchors.name: ctrl_e2_q
anchors.why: E2 control bits selecting mem/mul bypass and stall on load/store.

anchors.name: result_e2_q
anchors.why: E2 result register selected from div, CSR or ALU result.

anchors.name: result_e2_r
anchors.why: E2 bypass result mux choosing mem or mul result over result_e2_q.

anchors.name: exception_e2_r
anchors.why: Final E2 exception code from memory or pipeline; triggers squash and WB.

anchors.name: exception_e2_q
anchors.why: E2 exception register: interrupt, E1 or CSR exception.

anchors.name: csr_wr_e2_q
anchors.why: E2 CSR write request carried to writeback.

anchors.name: valid_e2_w
anchors.why: E2 valid and not stalled; enables bypass selection and rd_e2_o.

blocks.name: Writeback stage
blocks.description: Commit registers driving register-file and CSR writeback.

anchors.name: valid_wb_q
anchors.why: WB stage valid, cleared on memory fault exceptions.

anchors.name: ctrl_wb_q
anchors.why: WB control bits, rd_valid cleared on exception.

anchors.name: result_wb_q
anchors.why: WB result register from mem, mul or E2 result.

anchors.name: opcode_wb_q
anchors.why: WB opcode providing rd index and CSR address.

blocks.name: Hazard and flush control
blocks.description: Stall generation and exception-driven squash of pipeline stages.

anchors.name: issue_stall_i
anchors.why: Global pipeline stall holding E1, E2 and WB registers and gating outputs.

anchors.name: stall_o
anchors.why: Stall when divide or load/store result not complete; gates rd outputs.

anchors.name: squash_e1_e2_o
anchors.why: Exception squash flushing E1 and E2 stages.

anchors.name: squash_e1_e2_q
anchors.why: Registered squash extending flush one cycle.

anchors.name: squash_e1_e2_i
anchors.why: External flush request clearing E1/E2 stages.

anchors.name: squash_wb_i
anchors.why: External flush request clearing WB stage.

anchors.name: issue_valid_i
anchors.why: Issued instruction valid; with accept loads E1 stage registers.

anchors.name: issue_accept_i
anchors.why: Issue accept qualifying entry of instruction into E1.

blocks.name: Commit interface
blocks.description: Retired instruction results to regfile and CSR.

anchors.name: valid_wb_o
anchors.why: Commit valid for retiring instruction.

anchors.name: result_wb_o
anchors.why: Writeback result data to register file.

anchors.name: rd_wb_o
anchors.why: Writeback destination register index, zeroed when not writing.

anchors.name: exception_wb_o
anchors.why: Committed exception code output.

anchors.name: csr_write_wb_o
anchors.why: CSR write enable at commit.

blocks.name: Execution unit results
blocks.description: Results from ALU, CSR, memory, multiplier and divider plus forwarding outputs.

anchors.name: result_e2_o
anchors.why: E2 bypass result output for forwarding.

anchors.name: rd_e2_o
anchors.why: E2 destination register for forwarding/hazard detection.

anchors.name: rd_e1_o
anchors.why: E1 destination register for hazard detection.

anchors.name: alu_result_e1_i
anchors.why: ALU result captured into result_e2_q.

anchors.name: mem_result_e2_i
anchors.why: Load result bypassed into E2 and WB results.

anchors.name: mem_complete_i
anchors.why: Memory completion clearing load/store stall.

anchors.name: div_complete_i
anchors.why: Divider completion clearing divide stall.

biriscv_regfile.summary: Dual-issue RISC-V register file: 31 flop registers with two prioritized write ports (rd0 over rd1) and four asynchronous case-mux read ports.

blocks.name: register_array
blocks.description: 31 flop registers x1..x31, x0 hardwired zero, with debug alias wires.

anchors.name: REGFILE.reg_r1_q
anchors.why: Representative of the 31 flop registers x1..x31 holding architectural register values.

blocks.name: write_ports
blocks.description: Two write ports; rd0 has priority over rd1 per register.

anchors.name: rd0_i
anchors.why: Write port 0 destination register index; has priority when writing each register.

anchors.name: rd0_value_i
anchors.why: Write port 0 data written into selected register.

anchors.name: rd1_i
anchors.why: Write port 1 destination index, lower priority than rd0.

anchors.name: rd1_value_i
anchors.why: Write port 1 data written when rd1_i selects register.

blocks.name: read_muxes
blocks.description: Four asynchronous case-mux read ports returning zero for x0.

anchors.name: ra0_i
anchors.why: Read port index selecting register in the read case mux; representative of four read addresses.

anchors.name: ra0_value_o
anchors.why: Read port data output; representative of the four read value outputs.

anchors.name: REGFILE.ra0_value_r
anchors.why: Asynchronous read mux result selecting register by ra0_i.

biriscv_issue.summary: Dual-issue RISC-V issue stage: selects fetched words against expected PC, checks a scoreboard for hazards, reads a 2W4R regfile with bypass muxes, and dispatches to two pipe controllers and units.

blocks.name: Fetch slot select and PC
blocks.description: Matches fetch words to expected PC, selects slot A/B, detects mispredicts and redirects.

anchors.name: pc_x_q
anchors.why: Expected issue PC; advances by 4/8 on issue, reloaded on branch redirects.

anchors.name: slot0_valid_r
anchors.why: Fetch word 0 matches expected PC; selects which word feeds slot A.

anchors.name: slot1_valid_r
anchors.why: Fetch word 1 matches PC; muxes word 1 into slot A.

anchors.name: mispredicted_r
anchors.why: No fetch word matches PC; raises branch request for redirect.

anchors.name: branch_request_o
anchors.why: Fetch redirect request on CSR branch or misprediction.

anchors.name: branch_pc_o
anchors.why: Redirect target PC: CSR target or expected PC.

anchors.name: branch_csr_request_i
anchors.why: CSR/exception redirect; reloads PC and flushes fetch slots.

anchors.name: fetch0_valid_i
anchors.why: Fetch word 0 valid, compared with expected PC.

anchors.name: fetch0_instr_i
anchors.why: Fetched instruction word 0 entering slot A.

anchors.name: fetch0_accept_o
anchors.why: Accepts fetch word 0 when issued or skipped.

anchors.name: fetch1_valid_i
anchors.why: Fetch word 1 valid for slot B or slot A.

anchors.name: fetch1_accept_o
anchors.why: Accepts fetch word 1 on issue.

blocks.name: Issue scheduler and scoreboard
blocks.description: Hazard scoreboard, stall/pending blocking and dual-issue decision generating issue valids.

anchors.name: scoreboard_r
anchors.why: Per-register busy scoreboard blocking issue on RAW/WAW hazards.

anchors.name: opcode_a_issue_r
anchors.why: Primary slot issue valid driving pipe0 and unit opcode valids.

anchors.name: opcode_a_accept_r
anchors.why: Primary slot accepted; gates fetch accept and secondary issue.

anchors.name: opcode_b_issue_r
anchors.why: Secondary slot issue valid driving pipe1 when dual issue allowed.

anchors.name: stall_w
anchors.why: Combined pipe stall blocking issue and holding execution units.

anchors.name: squash_w
anchors.why: Pipeline squash invalidating both fetch slots.

anchors.name: dual_issue_ok_w
anchors.why: Checks instruction-pair compatibility enabling secondary slot issue.

anchors.name: div_pending_q
anchors.why: Divide in flight; blocks issue until divider result returns.

anchors.name: csr_pending_q
anchors.why: CSR op in flight; blocks issue and inhibits interrupts.

anchors.name: lsu_stall_i
anchors.why: LSU backpressure blocking issue of both slots.

anchors.name: take_interrupt_i
anchors.why: Interrupt take; suppresses dual issue and fetch accepts.

anchors.name: issue_a_csr_w
anchors.why: Slot A CSR instruction class; sets csr_pending and inhibits interrupts.

anchors.name: dual_issue_w
anchors.why: Both slots issued; advances PC by 8.

anchors.name: interrupt_inhibit_o
anchors.why: Inhibits interrupts during pending CSR operations.

blocks.name: Operand read and bypass
blocks.description: 2W4R register file read with WB/E2/E1 forwarding muxes for both slots.

anchors.name: issue_a_ra_value_r
anchors.why: Operand bypass mux choosing regfile, WB, E2 or E1 results.

anchors.name: opcode0_ra_operand_o
anchors.why: Slot 0 bypassed source operand to execution units.

anchors.name: opcode1_ra_operand_o
anchors.why: Slot 1 bypassed source operand to execution units.

anchors.name: pipe0_result_wb_w
anchors.why: Pipe0 writeback result written to regfile and bypassed.

anchors.name: pipe0_rd_wb_w
anchors.why: Pipe0 writeback destination register index.

anchors.name: issue_a_ra_idx_w
anchors.why: Slot A source register index for regfile read and scoreboard.

blocks.name: Pipe0 controller
blocks.description: Primary E1/E2/WB pipeline tracking slot 0 instructions and CSR writeback.

anchors.name: opcode0_opcode_o
anchors.why: Slot 0 instruction issued to exec0 and pipe0 controller.

anchors.name: exec0_opcode_valid_o
anchors.why: Exec0 ALU issue valid from primary slot.

anchors.name: pipe0_squash_e1_e2_w
anchors.why: Pipe0 exception squash clearing pending flags and pipe1.

anchors.name: csr_writeback_exception_o
anchors.why: Merged writeback exception code from both pipes.

blocks.name: Pipe1 controller
blocks.description: Secondary E1/E2/WB pipeline tracking slot 1 instructions.

anchors.name: opcode1_opcode_o
anchors.why: Slot 1 instruction issued to exec1 and pipe1 controller.

anchors.name: exec1_opcode_valid_o
anchors.why: Exec1 ALU issue valid from secondary slot.

blocks.name: Unit dispatch muxes
blocks.description: Steers slot 0 or slot 1 opcode and operands to LSU, multiplier, divider and CSR.

anchors.name: pipe1_mux_lsu_r
anchors.why: Routes slot 1 instead of slot 0 to the LSU outputs.

anchors.name: pipe1_mux_mul_r
anchors.why: Routes slot 1 instead of slot 0 to the multiplier outputs.

anchors.name: lsu_opcode_valid_o
anchors.why: LSU issue valid from selected slot.

blocks.name: Branch predictor info
blocks.description: Merges executed branch outcomes from both pipes for predictor training.

anchors.name: branch_info_request_o
anchors.why: Branch predictor update request on misprediction.
